name: Wastewander Justice
objectiveText: Take down 10 Wastewander Bandits and Thieves east of Gadgetzan, then report back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle .   Wastewander Bandit slain  ( 10 )   Wastewander Thief slain  ( 10 )

replies: concise and straight to the point. this is what thottbot is for! i love it. Thankyou. and yes, yes I am going way over the top with this!

comments.body: I completed this quest at level 42, and I got 3600 XP and an "increase" in Gadgetzan reputation.

For those that do have Cosmos the coords are:
60,24 for Bandits and a few Thiefs.
63,32 for more Thiefs than bandits with a few mages.

For those without Cosmose:
Go out the West gate at Gadgetzan and follow the mountains Northeast. You'll see some ruins,Noonshade,in the distance.  That's the location for Bandits and a few thiefs. After you clear that camp head Southwest and you will see a water tower off in the distance.  That is the location for more Thiefs than bandits with mages.  Remember this location because you'll need it for the next part of this chain.

Hope that helps.

These guys are all around south of Steamwheedle port, near the coords 62,35-ish. I soloed this as a 41 Human Mage. Pretty easy to do even if you accidentally pull several at a time. It seemed to me that bandits are much more prevalent than thieves.
[Classic] Both of the quest mobs share spawns with one another plus some Shadow Mages. Kill the others too rather than running around mindlessly looking for spawns you need.
i found a lot more mobs around 63,30

lol i was looking for ages,  but they were only 2 mins away, just go to the noonshade ruins east of Gadzetan and west of Steamwheeldle Port right in the middel of the 2 is a camp full of both targets 

Happy Hunting 

:D

When I did this I farmed the mobs at about 60.24 in the ruins. Often you will get either thieves or bandits faster than the other kind, and you may want to get respawns. It seems to be random whether thieves or bandits spawn, so kill both kinds, as they are very nice grinding targets anyhow.

You might wanna pick up the wastewander pouches both for the quest, and for turn-ins at Gadgetzan.

I found them at Noonshade Ruins East of Gadz.

Hope that helps on coords.
East of Gadgetzen. I did this quest solo and found them all there. Don't do this for the next quest however. :P

I love people who say they can't run addons. Anyone who can run wow and says they can't run addons is lying or is a moron. To run a tiny coordinate addon takes a miniscule amount of system resources, and if you have enough to run wow, you have enough to run the addon.

Follow the road east out of Gadgetazan until you're almost to Steamwheedle Port.  Directly south of the road these guys spawn in pretty decent numbers.  They are pretty hard to miss.

Happy hunting!
